rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; i8582 p. 10, Part IV, Caution: "Married individuals who file separate returns and lived with their spouses at any time during the tax year don’t qualify under the active participation rule and must use Part V instead of Part IV." The restatement’s Part IV classification (rental.part4 = rental.active) omits the caution, and the engine computes the case in Part IV: classm.f8582.4 hand-work expects line 2b -$213.20 while the project computes line 1b -$213.20 (BUG-0933).
